_comment: Run 8, N4: the real-world benchmark's answer key. Real bugs from public issue trackers, each fixed in an identifiable commit; the app runs at the fix's parent. Never shown to the agent (claude-cli runs outside this repo). See docs/REAL_WORLD.md.

react-admin._node: vite.config.ts imports package.json with `assert { type: 'json' }`, which Node 22+ rejects: the system Node 20 (universal binary), forced to arm64 to match the native modules installed.

bugs.title: Roman numeral converter accepts invalid numerals
bugs.description: Roman to Arabic: entering an invalid Roman numeral such as 'IVX' (or 'IXX') shows a number ('4') instead of rejecting it as invalid.

bugs.title: IPv4 address converter input can't be edited
bugs.description: On the IPv4 address converter, the IPv4 address input is read-only: the user can't change the example address.

bugs.title: Choosing RC4 in the decrypt panel makes the panel disappear
bugs.description: Encrypt / decrypt text: selecting RC4 as the algorithm in the Decrypt section makes the whole decrypt section disappear.
bugs.dropped: The reported symptom (the Decrypt panel disappears) does not reproduce at the fix's parent in headless Chromium: choosing RC4 throws an uncaught 'Malformed UTF-8 data' error, the choice doesn't apply and the dropdown stays open, but the panel stays. Replaced by IT-5 (reserve).

bugs.title: Favorite button on a tool page does nothing
bugs.description: On a tool's page, clicking the favorite button does not add the tool to the favorites (it works from the home page only).

bugs.title: OTP generator rejects a lower-case secret
bugs.description: OTP code generator: a lower-case base32 secret (e.g. 'abcd', as some services give them) is rejected with 'Secret should be a base32 string' and a wrong hexadecimal secret; the same secret in upper case works. Base32 is case-insensitive, so lower case should be accepted.

bugs.title: Clearing all filters on the orders list empties the list
bugs.description: Orders list: choosing 'clear all filters' (in the 'add filter' menu) shows no orders at all instead of all orders.

bugs.title: Previous/next buttons show the wrong position after paging
bugs.description: Opening a record from the second (or a later) page of a paginated list: the previous/next navigation on the record page shows the wrong index (it ignores the page number).

bugs.title: Tabs of an edit form beyond the first can't be opened
bugs.description: Edit page with tabs (a product): clicking a tab other than the first keeps showing the first tab, and the URL keeps growing with the clicked tab's index.
bugs._prepare_why: at this commit the demo imports data-generator-retail from its built dist/, which needs ra-core's types
bugs.dropped: Does not reproduce: at the fix's parent the demo's own yarn.lock resolves react-router 6.2.1, and the bug came with react-router 6.19+, which users got from fresh installs (the fix pins react-router below 6.19). The tabs work in the repo's demo. No replacement (time).
